name: 22102 · Mclean, VA
findings: ZIP 22102 (Mclean) has 271 nonprofit organizations. 123 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 108 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22102 (Mclean) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22102 (Mclean) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 108 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
